summary:
We developed an interactive space exploration and mission design game that allows players to experience different stages of a space mission, from spacecraft construction and launch to scientific research and return. Players can choose specialized character roles, each with unique abilities, and complete missions such as collecting samples, establishing orbits, exploring Mars, and investigating Jupiter's moon Europa.

The game combines space exploration, resource management, and scientific activities through interactive minigames inspired by real scientific instruments and analysis techniques. It also features multiplayer cooperation, allowing players to work together using their specialized skills, as well as a single-player mode with recruitable crew members and a creative mode for unrestricted exploration.

Our goal is to make space science and aerospace engineering more accessible and engaging by transforming complex mission concepts into an educational and interactive gaming experience.
details:
Our project is a 2D browser-based space exploration game designed to introduce children and young people to the concepts behind real space missions through an interactive and accessible experience. Players can build their own spacecraft using a modular system inspired by LEGO, selecting different components according to their mission objectives.
The game features several stages, including spacecraft construction and launch, scientific research, exploration, and return. Players can choose specialized character roles with unique abilities, complete scientific missions, collect samples, and explore different celestial bodies. The simulation uses real gravitational values, while certain processes are accelerated to make gameplay more dynamic and easier to understand.
The project aims to make space exploration more accessible and engaging by simplifying complex aerospace concepts without losing their scientific foundation. It encourages curiosity, problem-solving, creativity, and teamwork through cooperative multiplayer gameplay. Each player can contribute to a mission in different ways, while the creative sandbox mode allows unrestricted exploration and experimentation.
Our main creative approach is giving players the freedom to design their own strategies and spacecraft rather than following a single predetermined solution. We also considered accessibility, ensuring that the game can run directly in a web browser without requiring powerful hardware. The project was developed using JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, without external libraries or frameworks. We used Visual Studio Code, GitHub, and Vercel during development, alongside AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT for development assistance. We also used Gemini and ElevenMusic as part of the creative process. One of our biggest challenges was time management, as we aimed to develop a complete and engaging experience within a limited period.
